name: customer-account-home
title: Customer account home
description: The landing of 'My account': a greeting, the latest order with its status, and quick links with counts to orders, addresses, returns and help.
docs: Pass the customer's name and memberSince as an ISO date (shown as the month and the year). latestOrder carries the number, status (processing, shipped, delivered or cancelled), placedAt, items for the thumbnails (three are drawn, the rest become +2, itemCount says how many there are in all), total in minor units and deliveryDate: the status is written out in words, and while the order is on its way with a trackHref a Track link appears. Without an order the card becomes No orders yet with a Start shopping link (shopHref), so a new account never meets a hole. links are the tiles under it: label, href, an optional count (zero is shown), a hint line and an icon; the tiles wrap and the last row stretches, so there is never an empty cell. nudge is a slot under the grid for a loyalty note or a verification reminder. linkAs renders the links with your router's Link; renderImage plugs in next/image. locale and timeZone format the dates. It keeps no state, so it renders on the server. labels holds every word.
